failure_or_lesson: An episode summary is a derived interpretation. Persisting it without an independently checked source trail would turn a stale or invented narrative into apparent memory authority; register only candidates and revalidate source versions before use.
goal: Provide the selected episode persistence and evidence boundary so a separately qualified learned MFM can later supply candidate episodes.
notes: No synthetic candidate is called a learned episode; the model-dependent boundary remains open.
procedure: Validate product-neutral EpisodeRecord and direct source IDs; bind Experience to replay and encrypted raw bytes and Claim versions to current XTDB heads; store only metadata in XTDB and private summary/content in the encrypted object plane; serialize candidate generations; revalidate on every read.
validation: Real selected-backend run 36610759574 passed candidate write/read, source correction invalidation, stale predecessor rejection, and next-generation XTDB candidate replacement.
